# Document fixtures

All generated for this repository with LibreOffice 7 (headless, `--convert-to`) from small
hand-written sources; none is third-party content.

- `report.docx`, `report.pdf`: from an HTML page with a heading, two paragraphs ("The project
  codename is HERON-2291.") and a two-column table (Region/Units: North 1200, South 875).
- `sales.xlsx`: from a flat ODS with two sheets: "Q3" (Product/Units: Widget 42, Gadget 7.5) and
  "Notes" ("Audit code KESTREL-7740").
- `deck.pptx`: from a flat ODP with two slides ("Launch plan" / "Ship date is March 3", and "Risks
  and owners"); slide 1 has the speaker note "Speaker note: mention ALBATROSS-3306".
- `scanned.pdf`: an image-only page saved with Pillow ("Scanned memo: code PLOVER-1185"), with no
  text layer.
